body.name: \(\Pi_G(\mathcal O_G),\Pi_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)\)
body.construction:
Define the published-class compatible-order set by
\[
 \Pi_G(\mathcal O_G)=\left\{\pi\in\mathfrak S_V:\begin{array}{l}
 \text{there exist centered random vectors }\widetilde X,\widetilde\varepsilon
 \text{ with law }\widetilde P\text{ such that}\\
 (\widetilde P,B_\pi,\widetilde\varepsilon,\pi)\in
 \mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{pub}},\quad
 \widetilde X^{(a)}=B_\pi^{(a)}\widetilde X^{(a)}+
 \widetilde\varepsilon^{(a)},\\
 \operatorname{Cov}_{\widetilde P}(\widetilde X^{(a)},\widetilde X^{(b)})
 =\Sigma^{ab}\text{ for }a=b\text{ and for every }\{a,b\}\in E
 \end{array}\right\}.
\]
Define separately the component-aligned observable refinement
\[
 \Pi_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)=
 \left\{\pi\in\mathfrak S_V:
 \operatorname{offdiag}(R_\pi^{ab})=0\text{ for every }\{a,b\}\in E,
 \text{ and every }Q_{\pi,j}\text{ admits a completion in }\mathbb S_{++}^m
 \right\}.
\]
